Plan to shipment

Take a sales order stock cannot cover through planning, buying and building to a confirmed shipment.

Walked in LN, Aug 2026
Sales
Enterprise Planning
Procurement
Manufacturing
Warehousing

Before you start. Know each item's stock before you start: Check an item's inventory. The bamboo family as section 2 describes it. If any of it is missing, Create test items builds it and Run order planning Make the item visible to planning adds the planning data.

Start7 tasks · 42 steps

The tasks, in order

  1. 1PreflightAll three items are plannable, and every on-hand figure is written down · 5 steps
  2. 2Create the demandA sales order for more pairs than exist, inside the order horizon · 6 steps
  3. 3Run MRPPlanned orders cover the shortfall and reconcile in the pegging tree · 6 steps
  4. 4Cross the boundaryThe proposals become a real purchase order and a real production order · 6 steps
  5. 5Receive the componentsRods and sleeves are on hand at the raw-material warehouse · 5 steps
  6. 6Build the pairsThe finished item is posted to inventory · 7 steps
  7. 7ShipShipment Confirmed, on-hand down by the shipped quantity · 7 steps
    • PreflightAn item is absent from the Item Order Plan

      It has no cluster row. Step Preflight, step 5. Not an error state; nothing will tell you

    • Create the demandLN refuses the item on the sales order

      No row for the order's sales office on the Sales Offices tab of Item tcibd0501m100. Add it, then close and reopen the order session

    • Create the demandThe demand does not appear in the Item Order Plan

      The delivery date is beyond the Order Horizon date. Step Create the demand, step 5 — and the date is not today plus your days

    • Run MRPThe run plans the pair but not a component

      The component has no planning data of its own. Step Preflight, step 4 — MRP skips it silently

    • Run MRPA component has plan data and still produces nothing

      It may be correctly absent — planning proposes supply only for what stock does not cover. Read its own Item Order Plan and on-hand

    • Run MRPThe pegging tree is empty

      Pegging relations were not generated, or the demand is beyond the Pegging Horizon in Planning Parameters cprpd0100m000

    • Cross the boundaryThe transfer runs and nothing happens

      The orders were still Planned. Step Cross the boundary, step 3. There is no message for "nothing matched"

    • Cross the boundary"Buy-from BP cannot be determined for item …"

      No partner row on the item's Item - Business Partner tab. Steps Cross the boundary, steps 1–2. The failed proposal survives, so fix it and rerun

    • Cross the boundaryPurchase Order Type is blank

      LN gives an error. This environment defaults IPO

    • Receive the componentsNo inbound order appears after the transfer

      Check the purchase order's Release to Warehousing tab; Purchase Order Line Status tdpur4534m000 names the activity a stuck line is waiting on

    • Receive the componentswhinh0032 at the receipt

      Capture the LOG detail before clearing it, and read Errors Logged and Receipt Message Log whinh3530m000 afterwards

    • Receive the componentsThe receipt confirms but on-hand does not move

      Whether All Lines Final and All Lines Complete were both set, and whether you re-read the warehouse from Preflight, step 3

    • Build the pairsThe order will not release

      Printing Production Order Documents Mandatory in tisfc0100s000 may require Printed first

    • Build the pairsThe material line stays blocked

      Run Initiate Inventory Issue tisfc0207m000 manually; if still blocked, record what you saw

    • Build the pairsStatus reaches Production Completed and on-hand does not move

      That is the No path at Build the pairs, step 5. Check Warehousing Orders whinh2100m000 for an open production receipt order

    • ShipAdvice greyed out

      You are on the session toolbar. The advice actions live on the Outbound Lines toolbar — Ship, step 3

    • ShipThe order will not advise

      The header Warehouse does not hold the stock. Recheck against Preflight, step 2

    • ShipThe shipment will not confirm

      The line was never picked, or the shipment was never frozen. Steps Ship, step 4 and Ship, step 5

    The BOM is at revision 000002; revision 000001 was expired 2026-08-18. Routing 0 revision 000001, operation 10, work center A1000. One site, with raw materials and finished goods in two warehouses.

    Warning. BAM-ROD has a buy-from business partner and BAM-SLEEVE has not been checked. A buy-from business partner was added to BAM-ROD on 2026-08-25 because the transfer refused it without one. If MRP proposes a planned purchase order for BAM-SLEEVE, Cross the boundary will very likely fail on it the same way. Not documented for this release.

    • Stock already covers the order

      The YES branch of the flowchart. Planning generates no planned orders, and phases 2–5 do not happen at all — go straight to Ship from stock. MRP still runs; whether it generates anything depends on demand against on-hand plus on-order

    • The finished item is in the wrong warehouse to ship from

      Insert Warehouse transfer between phases 5 and 6. On current evidence BAM-CHOP-PAIR is received and shipped at the same finished-goods warehouse, so this does not arise

    • Components already in stock

      Cross the boundary transfers only the production side and Receive the components does not happen. This is the likely shape of a sleeve-only shortfall

    • Build by hand instead of from planning

      Skip Cross the boundary, step 6 and create the production order directly per Production order Create the production order. This is the only production path anyone here has walked — it is the fallback if Cross the boundary, step 6 fails

    • The shipment is Confirmed and on-hand has decreased

      None — the documented chain ends here. Invoicing and Financials are outside the library's scope by decision

    • Actual costs need calculating and posting

      Not documented for this release.
